title: Benchmark total (ms)

degradation.apply:
python3 - <<'EOF'
p='src/lib.rs'; s=open(p).read()
anchor='pub fn dedupe(items: &[u64]) -> Vec<u64> {\n'
assert s.count(anchor)==1, 'degradation anchor not found exactly once'
s=''+s.replace(anchor,'pub fn dedupe(items: &[u64]) -> Vec<u64> {\n    std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(20));\n',1)
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF

gaming_risks: bench inputs could be cached by seed
dedupe or count_words could special-case the benchmark input distribution
checksum could be faked by hard-coding outputs for the bench seed
[profile.release] tuning in Cargo.toml changes the number without changing the algorithm; flag for the judge
